requirement: Parse untrusted YAML configuration files using safe_load to prevent arbitrary Python code execution, verifying schema mappings and wrapping syntax errors.
skeleton: PipelineManifestParser class and parse_manifest helper with ConfigValidationError.

rationale.teaches: Parsing untrusted YAML with safe_load only, requiring a mapping root, checking every required key is present, and wrapping syntax errors.
rationale.why: yaml.load with the full or unsafe Loader parses every benign document identically and executes arbitrary Python on a crafted one. The fixture feeds a python/object tag and expects it to be rejected.

candidates.why_wrong: yaml.Loader is used, so a python/object tag in the manifest instantiates arbitrary classes.
A non-mapping root is accepted, so a scalar or list document passes as a manifest and breaks the next key lookup.
The key check is inverted, so a manifest with all required keys is rejected and one with none passes.
The empty required_keys guard compares a length to a negative number, so it never fires.
FullLoader is used, which still resolves python/name and other tags that safe_load refuses.
